title: Masamune-kun’s Revenge
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: As a chubby child, Masamune Makabe was cruelly rejected by wealthy Aki Adagaki and nicknamed 'Pig's Foot'. Years later, slim, handsome and vain under a new surname, he plots to make Aki fall for him and then humiliate her. It emerges that Aki's maid Yoshino, jealous at the time, disguised herself as Aki and delivered the rejection, and the revenge plot unravels as the misunderstanding comes to light.
life_message: It holds up honesty about one's feelings over pride and revenge, and suggests that misunderstandings can be repaired.
